GuiScalingUtils.luau.description: Scale ratios for the UI on different devices Public entry points include `getViewportAlpha`, `GuiScalingUtils.getUIScale`, `GuiScalingUtils.observeUIScale`, `GuiScalingUtils.observeUIScaleForChild`, `GuiScalingUtils.createUIScale`, `GuiScalingUtils.createDialogPadding`, `GuiScalingUtils.observeDialogPadding`, `GuiScalingUtils.getDialogPadding`.

GuiUltrawideContainerUtils.luau.description: Creates a 1920x1080 scaling container to handle ultrawide monitors and screens in a reasonable way. This helps keep UI centered and available for ultrawide screens. Public entry points include `GuiUltrawideContainerUtils.createContainer`, `GuiUltrawideContainerUtils.scaleSizeConstraint`.

JumpButtonUtils.luau.description: Utility functions to deal with Roblox's mobile jump button and its position Public entry points include `JumpButtonUtils.getJumpButtonPositionAndSize`.

PlayerGuiUtils.luau.description: Helper methods for finding and retrieving the [PlayerGui] instance Public entry points include `PlayerGuiUtils.getPlayerGui`, `PlayerGuiUtils.findPlayerGui`.

RxGuiInteractionUtils.luau.description: Rx Gui Interaction Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Guiutils package. Public entry points include `GuiInteractionUtils.observeInteractionEnabled`, `GuiInteractionUtils.observeInteractionEnabledBrio`.

UIAlignmentUtils.luau.description: Utility methods for working with horizontal and vertical alignment Public entry points include `UIAlignmentUtils.toNumber`, `UIAlignmentUtils.verticalToHorizontalAlignment`, `UIAlignmentUtils.horizontalToVerticalAlignment`, `UIAlignmentUtils.toBias`, `UIAlignmentUtils.horizontalAlignmentToNumber`, `UIAlignmentUtils.horizontalAlignmentToBias`, `UIAlignmentUtils.verticalAlignmentToNumber`, `UIAlignmentUtils.vertical.

UICornerUtils.luau.description: UICorner Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Guiutils package. Public entry points include `UICornerUtils.fromScale`, `UICornerUtils.fromOffset`, `UICornerUtils.clampPositionToFrame`.
